description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'DestroyPurgeStrategyTest' that tests the 'DestroyPurgeStrategy' class, part of the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It sets up the test environment, runs a purge operation, and asserts that employee pictures related to a specific employee are deleted.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the DestroyPurgeStrategy in OrangeHRM's maintenance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of DestroyPurgeStrategy with specific parameters and populating test data.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Tests the 'purge' method of DestroyPurgeStrategy, verifying that employee pictures for employee with ID 1 are removed.
